shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, no-space-parity + retention-pinned island logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view. Underground biome trial notes in pass 16.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **Logistics doctrine (rewritten pass 32, anti-carousel): every ferry is MONOTONE.** (1) Storage moves are exactly vanilla: verdict only when StoreUtility finds strictly-better storage WITH SPACE; job count clamps to the destination's absorbable capacity (AbsorbCapacity: container GetCountCanAccept, or slot-group free-cell sum capped at one stack, mirroring NoStorageBlockersIn). No space anywhere -> no haul. (2) Demand pulls are shortfall-driven AND retention-backed: raw consumer requirement (bill counts, mouths x meals, live refuel gap via GetFuelCountToFullyRefuel ITEM counts, transporter manifests) registers as requirementOnly sites -> island consumableRequired; PinnedByNativeNeed (generalized from construction-only) blocks export by ANY flow while island avail minus the stack < native construction + consumable requirement. Condition-based, not timer-based: pin lifts itself when the want ends, surplus flows home once. (3) In-flight ledger nets en-route cargo; landed cargo is owned by retention. Timer import pin (2500t) kept only as grace for storage-move cargo. ALL carried-cargo continuations target the LANDED thing (merge-safe).
- Needs-bridge doctrine: postfix the vanilla giver, keep any real local result, re-run the giver's own guard chain, probe linked levels virtually with the SAME vanilla finder, one-hop stairs job, giver re-fires on arrival; per-pawn fail cooldowns.
- **Work-migration hysteresis (pass 32 stair-thrash fix): post-arrival commitment.** StairTransfer calls CrossLevelWork.NoteArrived for every player-faction arrival: charges a PLAIN (non-versioned, version-bump-immune) arrivalCommitment cooldown + re-arms migrationCooldown from the ARRIVAL tick (probe-time charges eroded in transit — the "up, 5s of work, back down" bug). Gates TryMigrateForBetterWork and ProbeWorkAt (robot path). Emergency migration exempt; player orders, needs bridges, local WorkGivers (incl. ferries) unaffected. Version bumps (designation/blueprint) now fire ONLY for level-linked maps.

## REMOVED FEATURES (postmortems preserved)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — postmortem pass 16. **MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed per user; revisit dossier in pass 22 schematic + lore (biomes).

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · bug-wave fixes "mostly fixed" (USER): mech charge crash gone, bill supply + mech RMB working.

## RECENT FIX HISTORY (passes 23-25, 32)
Pass 23: Invoke(null) fix + demand fan-cap + forbidden-aware availability + mech RMB. Pass 24: ferry discipline (ledger/clamps/onward hop). Pass 25: merge-kill fix + bill-product continuation. **Pass 32 (USER PLAYTEST REPORTS — stair thrash + log carousel): (a) storage-ferry capacity clamp (no-space parity), (b) generalized condition-based retention pin (PinnedByNativeNeed) replacing construction-only + timer, (c) refuel demand in item counts, (d) work-migration arrival commitment + version-bump gating. Root causes documented in the doctrine bullets above. NOT YET USER-VERIFIED.**

(b) stair thrash dead: priority-1 job upstairs + low-priority work downstairs -> pawn climbs once, chews through the priority work, no up-down oscillation; after any crossing the pawn commits ~20s (slider-scaled) before probe-migrating again.**

## Status
2026-07-25 (32nd pass): **Anti-thrash pass built green off two user playtest reports.** (1) Stair-thrash: arrival commitment cooldown (version-bump-immune) + arrival-tick recharge + bump gating to linked maps. (2) Log carousel: storage ferries clamp to destination absorbable capacity (no-space vanilla parity); demand imports retained by CONDITION (PinnedByNativeNeed: raw requirement vs island availability) instead of a 2500-tick timer; refuel demand uses GetFuelCountToFullyRefuel item counts. Cycle-impossibility argument: every ferry now either strictly improves storage priority into guaranteed space or covers a live retained want. NEEDS the pass-32 test (queue item 0-pre) before anything else.
